title: Current-epoch EEG spectral power modestly improved next-stage-change prediction in two held-out Sleep-EDF participants
abstract: In a bounded public Sleep-EDF subset, a fixed logistic model adding current 30-s Fpz-Cz log band powers to current scored stage lowered participant-averaged next-stage-change log loss in both held-out people by 0.00878 on average. The exact participant-level sign-flip p was 0.50 (n=2), so this is a small, scoped predictive association rather than confirmatory, causal, clinical, or independent-dataset evidence. Median-PSD and non-wake sensitivities retained direction; a development-label permutation control performed worse. Code, output hashes, provenance, and limitations are included; raw EDF data are not redistributed.
